_: WHAT A REVEALED MAGIC ITEM IS FOR. Copy to substrate/magic-keep.json — that path is
gitignored, because a keep list is ORDERS TO A FLEET and not a description of one.
Four verdicts, and the split is by WHO BUYS IT:
keep             back to the character it came from
sell_to_players  held and tagged for the menagerie merchant, who sells to real people
sell_to_npc      a TIMED attribute: sold at a counter on the trip it was revealed on,
because the timer runs in the vault too and the value decays
unknown          nothing matched. NOT a sale — a missing line in this file.
Every entry is matched as a case-insensitive SUBSTRING against the item's name AND its
look text after a reveal. Seven of this game's twelve permanent weapon attributes do not
rename the item at all, so the look-text signature is usually the only handle: see
WEAPON_ATTRIBUTES in tools/m59-magicsort.mjs for the table and its kod citations.
The committed default is derived from that table (permanent and difficulty >= 8 keeps,
permanent and weaker sells to players, timed sells to a counter). This file REPLACES it
rather than adding to it — an empty or unparseable file keeps the default and says so.
